_doc: Who built a station (scripts/board/station_races.gd, scripts/board/station_gen.gd _roll_races). Each station has one or more builder races (species.json ids). In a race's home region (regions/*.json home_species) a station is a single race's work at `single` chance by type (outpost mostly, habitat rarely), else mixed: `mixed` [min, max] races, the home race first, the rest drawn by weight from the region's `neighbours` (and humans, `human_weight`). Outside any home region a station is always mixed, drawn from the region's neighbours (`default_neighbours` when the region has none listed). In a mixed station each module is a section of one race: it keeps its parent's race at `stay` chance, else takes another of the station's races; a race-only module (a module's `race`) is always its race's. A race changes only the SKIN of a section: `skin` (floor and wall tints, lamp colour, signage glyph) and `variants` (the art a fixture is drawn with: fixture id -> variant id; the footprint is the same), never footprints, doors, lanes or container counts. No ship_styles.json exists on main yet: the colours here are this file's own; when it lands, the skins can read its palettes. What the body of a race lets its sections be comes from its traits (species.json, traits.json), read by station_races.gd: `airless_ok` (needs no air: o2_use 0 or vacuum_walk) sections may be operational and airless, fully lit (`airless_chance`); a power trait (`power`: trait key -> x the chance a section has power in a half-active station); a `climate` (`climate`: a trait test -> hot or cold, shown in the dressing, nothing more). items: the gear a race's sections hold more of (loot.gd weights them within the tier, like a room's tags); parts and recipes whose id starts with a race's `prefix` count too.
